name: comp-113
title: Pinned Options Split Button
blurb: Dropdown chevron paired with a Pinned action button.
description: Two grouped primary buttons: a dropdown chevron icon and a 'Pinned' button with pin icon. Divided with a subtle line.
use_when: Offering a pinned status with additional dropdown options.
avoid_when: When the dropdown functionality is not implemented.
a11y: Uses aria-label on the dropdown button and aria-hidden on icons.
